subject: English
passage: Energy-conservation programs in office buildings can be effective, says researcher Kahu Mataira of Stanford University in California, when these programs involve employee participation: for example, one corporation achieved a 35 percent reduction in electricity use after building managers were instructed to ask workers whether ______ needed their desk lights on during lunch breaks.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The convention being tested is pronoun–antecedent agreement. The plural pronoun "they" agrees in number with the plural antecedent "workers."
